description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git status' command with various options and scenarios. It includes setup procedures, expected output definitions, and sequence of Git commands to verify repository states under different conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with specific setup and command assertions.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test case completes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files, asserting their equality.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that is expected to fail and ensures it does.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the given output or file is empty.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global configuration options for tests, e.g., allowing file protocol in Git.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, signaling test completion.

calls: git push (assuming) or git submodule commands used
